tasks.label: simulate-new-kg
tasks.command:
python3 -c "
import json

# Load enriched data
with open('/Users/futuremeng/.TraceView/978-7-111-74324-8_1-1_2/semantic/enriched_result.json') as f:
    er = json.load(f)

blocks = er.get('blocks',[])
cross = er.get('cross_block_relations',[])

# Simulate what BuildEnrichedKnowledgeGraph would produce
nodes = {}  # id -> node
for b in blocks:
    for e in b.get('entities',[]):
        if e.get('validation_status') == 'invalid':
            continue
        nid = f\"node_{e['category']}_{e['normalized']}\"
        if nid not in nodes:
            n = {
                'id': nid,
                'label': e.get('enriched_text') or e['text'],
                'category': e['category'],
                'freq': 1,
                'extId': e.get('external_id',''),
                'src': e.get('enrichment_source',''),
                'status': e.get('validation_status',''),
            }
            # LOCATION coords from metadata
            if e['category'] == 'LOCATION':
                for m in e.get('metadata',[]):
                    if '=' in m:
                        k,v = m.split('=',1)
                        if k in ('latitude','longitude'):
                            n[k] = v
            nodes[nid] = n
        else:
            nodes[nid]['freq'] += 1

edges = set()
for b in blocks:
    for r in b.get('relations',[]):
        edges.add((r['source_entity_id'], r['target_entity_id'], r['relation_type']))

# Summary
cats = {}
for n in nodes.values():
    c = n['category']
    cats[c] = cats.get(c,0)+1

with_qid = sum(1 for n in nodes.values() if n['extId'])
with_enrich = sum(1 for n in nodes.values() if n['src'])
with_coords = sum(1 for n in nodes.values() if 'latitude' in n)

print('=== Upgraded Knowledge Graph (simulated) ===')
print(f'Nodes: {len(nodes)} (down from 5008, filtered invalid)')
print(f'Edges (typed): {len(edges)}')
print(f'Cross-block relations: {len(cross)}')
print()
print('Node categories:')
for c,n in sorted(cats.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
    print(f'  {c}: {n}')
print()
print(f'Nodes with Wikidata Q-ID: {with_qid}')
print(f'Nodes with enrichment source: {with_enrich}')
print(f'Location nodes with coordinates: {with_coords}')
print()
print('Sample enriched nodes:')
for n in list(nodes.values())[:8]:
    extra = ''
    if n['extId']: extra += f' QID={n[\"extId\"]}'
    if n['src']: extra += f' src={n[\"src\"]}'
    if 'latitude' in n: extra += f' ({n[\"latitude\"]},{n[\"longitude\"]})'
    print(f'  [{n[\"category\"]}] {n[\"label\"]}{extra}')
"
